mapper.select: select mn.* ,u.U_Name as dispatchUname,c.C_Name as constructionContractorName,c2.C_Name as auditUnitName from annual_plan mn left join sys_user u on mn.Dispatch_Uid = u.U_ID left join sys_company c on mn.Construction_Contractor = c.C_ID left join sys_company c2 on mn.Audit_Unit = c2.C_ID where mn.id = #{id}

select mn.* ,u.U_Name as dispatchUname,c.C_Name as constructionContractorName,c2.C_Name as auditUnitName from annual_plan mn left join sys_user u on mn.Dispatch_Uid = u.U_ID left join sys_company c on mn.Construction_Contractor = c.C_ID left join sys_company c2 on mn.Audit_Unit = c2.C_ID where mn.start_Time <= #{yearEnd} and mn.end_Time >= #{yearStart} and mn.state = 7 order by mn.create_time desc limit 1
